name: Protopine
summary: Protopine is an alkaloid occurring in opium poppy, Corydalis tubers and other plants of the family papaveraceae, like Fumaria officinalis. It has been found to inhibit histamine H1 receptors and platelet aggregation, and acts as an analgesic.

pharmacology.text: It has been found to inhibit histamine H1 receptors and platelet aggregation, and acts as an analgesic.

summaryZh: 原鴉片鹼（英語：protopine）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C20H19NO5，是存在於罌粟、紫堇等植物中的生物鹼。

uses.en: It is present in Corydalis, which is used in traditional Chinese medicine for pain, and it is studied in the laboratory for its effects on inflammation and blood clotting. It is not an approved medicine on its own.
uses.zh: 它存在於延胡索中，延胡索在中醫裡用於止痛，實驗室也在研究它對發炎和血液凝固的作用。它本身並不是核准的藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它存在于延胡索中，延胡索在中医里用于止痛，实验室也在研究它对发炎和血液凝固的作用。它本身并不是核准的药物。

fact.en: Protopine has an unusual ten-membered ring containing a nitrogen atom, and it is found in many plants of the poppy family, including the opium poppy and Corydalis.
fact.zh: 原鴉片鹼帶有一個罕見、含氮原子的十元環，存在於許多罌粟科植物中，包括罌粟和延胡索。
fact.zhHans: 原鸦片碱带有一个罕见、含氮原子的十元环，存在于许多罂粟科植物中，包括罂粟和延胡索。
